edges.reason: unlock() writes _owner back to _previousOwner.
lock() zeroes _owner and stores it in _previousOwner.
transferOwnership reads and updates _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
unlock() reads _previousOwner for the permission check and restores it as owner.
lock() stores the current _owner into _previousOwner.
unlock() requires block.timestamp > _lockTime.
lock() writes _lockTime = block.timestamp + time.
claimTokens reads marketingWallet as the ETH destination.
swapAndLiquify reads marketingWallet for the marketing ETH share.
swapAndLiquify uses marketingFeePercent to size the marketing share.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for approval and swap.
addLiquidity reads uniswapV2Router for approval and liquidity call.
_transfer compares from with uniswapV2Pair before swapping.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount for the transfer limit and balance cap.
_transfer reads numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity for the swap threshold.
_transfer reads _maxWalletSize for the recipient wallet size check.
swapAndLiquify writes inSwapAndLiquify through the lockTheSwap modifier.
_transfer reads swapAndLiquifyEnabled before triggering a swap.
_tokenTransfer reads canTrade to gate non-owner transfers.
_tokenTransfer reads botWallets for sender and recipient bot checks.
_tokenTransfer reads botscantrade to allow or block bot wallets.
_tokenTransfer indirectly uses _taxFee through _getValues.
_tokenTransfer indirectly uses _liquidityFee through _getValues.
setMaxTxAmount writes _maxTxAmount.
setSwapThresholdAmount writes numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity.
setTaxFeePercent writes _taxFee.
setLiquidityFeePercent writes _liquidityFee.
_setMaxWalletSizePercent writes _maxWalletSize.
allowtrading writes canTrade to true.
_transfer conditionally invokes swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth on the first half.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the remaining ETH.
swapAndLiquify sends the marketing share of ETH to marketingWallet.
claimTokens sends the entire contract balance to marketingWallet.
clearStuckBalance transfers the contract balance to the supplied address.
claimOtherTokens performs an external ERC20 transfer on an arbitrary token.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swap entrypoint.
addLiquidity calls the router addLiquidityETH entrypoint with value.
transferFrom delegates the actual movement to _transfer.
airdrop uses _transfer after removing fees.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the stored allowance.
_transfer triggers reflection supply math through _getValues and _getRate.
swapAndLiquify queries balanceOf, which uses reflection arithmetic.
_tokenTransfer triggers reflection supply math through the transfer variants.
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender so the previous owner can reclaim ownership at will.
claimTokens is guarded by onlyOwner comparing _owner with _msgSender().
lock() is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting the lock to the current owner.
setTaxFeePercent is owner-only and can change fees on live transfers.
airdrop is owner-only yet can move arbitrary token amounts out of the owner balance.
claimOtherTokens is owner-only but lets the owner sweep any ERC20 held by the contract.
lock() derives _lockTime directly from block.timestamp, making the lock duration miner-influenceable.
unlock() compares block.timestamp against _lockTime, a timestamp dependent ownership condition.
The Uniswap swap can make the pair call back into the token transfer path while swapAndLiquify is executing.
During the router swap the pair can re-enter _transfer; the lockTheSwap flag is the only guard.
The addLiquidityETH call transfers control to the router and pair, which can call back into the token.
The router/pair callback returns into swapAndLiquify after state has only partially been updated.
ETH transfer to marketingWallet forwards only the 2300 gas stipend, so meaningful reentrancy is unlikely.
clearStuckBalance uses address.transfer with the 2300 gas stipend, limiting callback depth.
Arbitrary ERC20 transfer in claimOtherTokens re-enters an untrusted token, but no state changes follow.
